description: This file defines several reusable UI components for a React application, including Card, Modal, Toast, and StatusBadge, each with specific UI functionalities and accessibility features.

methods.name: Card({ title, right, children, footer })
methods.description: A flexible card container component with optional title, right section, footer, and children content.

methods.name: Modal({ open, title, children, footer, onClose })
methods.description: An accessible modal dialog component that supports overlay click and Escape key to close, displaying a title, content, and footer.

methods.name: Toast
methods.description: A minimal, auto-closing notification component that displays a message with a title and a dismiss button.

methods.name: StatusBadge
methods.description: A component that displays a color-coded badge based on order status, supporting statuses like DELIVERED, CANCELLED, etc.

ctags.name: Card
ctags.pattern: /^export function Card({ title, right, children, footer }) {$/

ctags.name: Modal
ctags.pattern: /^export function Modal({ open, title, children, footer, onClose }) {$/
